providers.intro: Use your own provider account when you choose cloud processing. Local processing remains available without connecting anything.
providers.trademarks: Provider names and marks belong to their respective owners and identify the service you connect.
providers.setupHint: Enter your API key. We’ll find the available models and configure supported features for you.
providers.localHint: Connect to the local server. The server controls whether its selected models run locally or use a remote service.
providers.optionalToken: API token (if your server requires one)
providers.destination: Connect stores your key securely and checks model metadata at {host|ltr}. It does not send book text or generate content.
providers.configuredHint: Configured access. Content is generated only when you choose this provider.
providers.proposal: Recommended settings for future work. Apply to use them; existing jobs and sessions keep their recorded settings.
providers.partial: The model list is incomplete. Refresh to try again; your current settings are kept.
providers.voicesPartial: Some voices could not be checked. Available saved or documented voices are shown.
providers.error.key: This key was not accepted. Check it and try again.
providers.error.permission: This key cannot access the required metadata. Check its permissions with your provider.
providers.error.quota: The provider is limiting requests or needs available credit. Try again later or check your provider account.
providers.error.network: Couldn’t reach the provider. Check your connection and try again.
providers.error.models: No supported default was found. Open Advanced settings to choose a model.
providers.error.changed: The model list changed. Refresh and review the recommendations again.
providers.error.storage: Couldn’t save the key. Unlock your key storage or use session-only storage in Manage keys.
providers.error.generic: Couldn’t finish setup. Your existing settings are kept. Try again or open Advanced settings.
providers.customHint: Configure your own endpoint in Advanced settings.
providers.name: Name
providers.error.connection: Enter a name, endpoint if required, and model. Check that the endpoint uses HTTPS or a loopback address.
providers.copy.28: Each row is one book you agreed to send to this provider. Revoking is recorded, not deleted; the next cast asks again.
providers.copy.29: Cast consents could not be read
providers.copy.32: The key vault is locked — key validity is unknown until it is unlocked.
providers.copy.36: Named, stable, and yours: rename keeps recorded jobs intact; disable stops new selection without touching history.
providers.copy.47: One key per line; blank lines and # comments are skipped.
providers.copy.52: No list fetched yet. Fetching asks the provider once; nothing runs in the background.
providers.copy.53: Add a key in the pool below to list this provider's models — or type a model id.
providers.copy.54: Voice saved — it appears in the cast form's voice picker.
providers.copy.59: Remove this key? The stored bytes are deleted; rotation skips the slot immediately.
providers.copy.60: Keys stored here will be sent only to
providers.copy.61: . Voice sessions send this endpoint your microphone audio, book excerpts, and — when you ask about a page — an image of that page. Allow this endpoint?
providers.copy.62: Deletion is blocked: what this connection still supports could not be verified (
providers.copy.64: its cast consents end with it
providers.copy.65: the impact report did not match the expected shape
providers.figuresUnavailable: This model cannot read images. Turn off figure explanation for this cast or choose a model that supports images.
providers.cacheStale: fetched {count|n} days ago — may be stale
providers.finishHint: Your key is saved. Finish setup to configure models and voices without entering it again.
providers.retirementNotice: {model|ltr} is scheduled to retire on {date|ltr}. Refresh to review an available replacement.

providers.deleteJobs.one: {count|n} unfinished job will refuse and offer Local
providers.deleteJobs.other: {count|n} unfinished jobs will refuse and offer Local

providers.error.discovery: This service cannot list models for this key. Open Advanced settings to configure a documented model manually.
providers.figuresUnknown: Image support is not verified for {connection|bdi} · {model|ltr}. Keep figures only if this model supports images, or turn figure explanation off for this cast.
